title: Crispy Indian Toast
description: A simple and flavorful recipe to make crispy Indian-style toast. Perfect as a side dish or snack.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Brush both sides of each bread slice with light.
Heat a tablespoon of oil in the pan and place 2 slices of bread.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown.
Flip the toast over and cook for another 2 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining bread slices.
